UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

Product description

Shiva Exim lists dried maize grain for cattle feed. Buyers should provide the feed-grain specification, including moisture, broken kernels, foreign matter, damaged kernels and required contaminant testing. The proposed lot and quality reports must be assessed for the intended cattle-feed application.

This is a cattle-feed grain enquiry, not an offer of human-consumption maize, popcorn, fresh sweet corn or planting seed. Export eligibility, feed-quality requirements and lot evidence are confirmed before an order.

Common applications

Cattle feed; cattle-feed milling and compound-feed processing.

Specification status

Product form, quality limits, availability and lot test results are agreed with the final offer.

PRACTICAL BUYING DETAILS

Before you choose a lot.

Match the product, specification and commercial terms.

Product questions

What is this maize supplied for?

This listing is for cattle feed and cattle-feed processing. It is not a human-consumption maize or popcorn offer. Popcorn remains a separate import product.

What should I include in a cattle-feed maize enquiry?

Specify moisture, broken kernels, foreign matter, damaged grain and any test-weight or feed-analysis requirements. Include required mycotoxin and other contaminant tests, quantity, packing, destination and shipment period.

Is feed quality or non-GMO status guaranteed by the name?

No. Agree the cattle-feed specification and any GMO-status requirement with supporting lot evidence. A product name is not a lot test report or a blanket compliance guarantee.

For your export enquiry

  • Product form, grade and intended use
  • Origin, crop year and lot or sample reference
  • Target quality values and required test methods
  • Net quantity, bag or container size and liner preference
  • Destination or origin port and shipment period
  • Required documents and any sample request

Packing, storage & shelf life

Tell us the packing format and net weight you require. Bag construction, liner, labelling and pallet requirements are agreed with the offer. Confirm the lot’s storage conditions, shelf life or relevant dates rather than assuming a standard duration.

For feed products, agree the intended application, feed-quality testing and lot-specific storage and handling instructions.
